description: This file defines an abstract class 'FilterField' within the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Core\Report\FilterField'. The class is part of a reporting filter system for the OrangeHRM system, providing properties and methods for managing filter configuration such as order, entity aliases, operators, and criteria (x and y). It includes abstract methods for query integration and entity alias retrieval, indicating that subclasses implement specific filtering behaviors.

classes.name: FilterField
classes.description: An abstract base class for report filter fields, managing filter parameters and requiring subclasses to implement query modification and alias retrieval.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for initializing filter field properties like operator, x, y, and order.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Abstract method that subclasses implement to add filter conditions to a query builder.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve entity aliases relevant to this filter.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Returns the order of the filter field.

methods.name: getOperator
methods.description: Returns the operator used in the filter.

methods.name: modifyX
methods.description: Allows modification of the x parameter via a callable.

methods.name: modifyY
methods.description: Allows modification of the y parameter via a callable.
